messages:
jules_support: FYI — customer reports promo code PRONEW50 returns "invalid or expired" at checkout. They say the same code worked for a teammate. Customer account id: acct_01H3XXXX (PII redacted). Screenshot attached.

sam_billing: Can you paste the raw code + account id? Also did they recently change plans or migrate orgs? :thinking_face:

jules_support: Code=PRONEW50, acct=acct_01H3XXXX. Notes: they upgraded from Free -> Pro yesterday via self-serve. Said they never redeemed this promo on their account before.

ben_eng: Quick hypothesis: coupon scope might be "new_accounts_only" or single-use and there's a migration flag on the account that makes it look ineligible. Can you share checkout logs? If you have an error trace, paste it.

jules_support: Pasting last 3 lines of checkout response we got from customer:
```
{"status":"error","code":"coupon_rejected","reason":"invalid_or_expired","detail":"coupon_scope_mismatch"}
```

sam_billing: Looking in billing DB now — query I'm running:
```
SELECT id, code, expires_at, usage_limit, scope
FROM coupons
WHERE code = 'PRONEW50';
```

ops-bot: Billing query complete (results attached).

sam_billing: Results: code PRONEW50 exists, expires_at=2026-02-28, usage_limit=1, scope=["new_accounts_only"], used_count=0. So not consumed but scoped.

ben_eng: That lines up with coupon_scope_mismatch. The kicker: when orgs migrate from legacy free tier to new Pro, we set metadata flag `migrated_from_legacy:true`. Our eligibility check currently treats that flag as non-new. In other words the customer qualifies in intent but our service flags them as ineligible. I can reproduce locally.

ben_eng: Repro steps (local):
```
# simulate checkout
POST /v1/checkout apply_coupon
payload: {"acct":"acct_01H3XXXX","coupon":"PRONEW50"}
=> response: {"error":"coupon_scope_mismatch"}
```

jules_support: Ugh. Customer is legit and expects the credit. What's the workaround?

ben_eng: Short term: billing can add the credit manually or flip the migrated flag for that account. Long term: we'll relax the scope check to allow accounts with migrated_from_legacy if they have no prior promo redemptions. I'll open a PR and a tracking ticket.

sam_billing: I issued a manual promotional credit of $150 to acct_01H3XXXX and linked it to case #CS-1529. Notified customer via email — awaiting confirmation. I also toggled a one-off override in the coupon backend to allow redemption if they attempt again. :white_check_mark:

jules_support: Nice. Told customer they should see credits applied and to retry checkout. Asked them to confirm.

ben_eng: Filed ticket to fix logic: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2487 — description: "Coupon scope incorrectly excludes migrated-from-legacy accounts with no prior redemptions". Assigned to eng-payment. Added unit test and TODO for release notes.

sam_billing: Also added audit entry for manual credit and created follow-up task for billing to run a report of affected accounts (label: billing/cleanup).

jules_support: I'll mark this thread resolved once customer confirms. Thank you all. :pray: 

ops-bot: THREAD CLOSED by jules_support at 1938753600
